correctness.rationale: Reconstructed source optimized squeeze s=(1/2)asinh(u sinh2r) (u=coth(beta/2)>1) and rationalized R_opt^2=u cosh2r (u^2-1)/(u cosh2r+sqrt(1+u^2 sinh^2 2r)). For every finite r this strictly exceeds (u^2-1)/2 and tends to that limit; <= or > 1 precisely across beta_c=log(2+sqrt3). Therefore fidelity lower bound is zero for ALL finite r if beta<=beta_c. For beta>beta_c, F_opt tends to (1-1/(sqrt2 sinh(beta/2)))^2>0; using source geometric B_k=1-tanh^(2k)(s), strict inequality and log tanh^2 s~-4 exp(-2r)/u gives certified K_fid~(u/4)[-log(1-(1-a_beta)^2)]exp(2r). Separately exp h(u exp(-2r))~e exp(2r)/(4u) via source EoF bound, so no claim of physical separability. Independently checked rationalization/limit for representative beta,r numerically; analytic proof determines all parameter values.
